prompt:

Source sentences:
S122: The Hospital Liaison Desk coordinates destination information with the receiving Emergency Department when required.
S123: Radio Coordinator sends the Coverage Gap Bulletin when available ambulance coverage falls below the regional threshold.
S207: Radio Coordinator uses the change card to adjust channel assignments and record the effective time of each change.
S208: Shift Commander receives the Coverage Gap Bulletin and decides whether staffing or deployment adjustments are needed.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Radio Coordinator produces or sends this item AND that Shift Commander receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
